All Regional P.F. Commissioners -In-Charge of Regions/

All Regional P.F. Commissioners -In-Charge of Sub Regional Offices

Sub: Stray Instances of Dishonor of Cheques

Ref : (i) This Office letter No. Bkg.1(5)2006/Agreement/Part dtd. 12.04.2010

(ii)This Office letter No. Bkg.1(5)2006/Agreement/Part/2026 dtd. 29.04.2010

Sir,

Instances have come to the notice of Head Office on dishonor of cheques at
different Regional and Sub Regional Offices. The issue was taken up with State Bank
of India on 01.10.2010 while signing the Banking Agreement. The Central Provident
Fund Commissioner has expressed his concern on such dishonor of cheques. To
overcome the situation, following instructions are issued for strict compliance:

1.

All the Officers in Charge of Regional and Sub Regional offices shall closely
monitor the Fund position with the Link Branches of State bank of India
under their jurisdiction in Account No.] and Account No.10 on daily basis
and to draw a strategy so that the cheques issued by them are within the
overdraft limit allowed.

Since the quantum of cheques issued and amount to be debited on
account of such cheques are available with Regional and Sub Regional
Offices, it should be ensured that while issuing fresh cheques the position of
cheques issued but not presented at the bank and the amounts involved
therein should be monitored in such a way that there is no dishonor of
cheques.

The trend of debits from Account No. 1 & 10 may be evaluated on monthly
basis and while doing so, if there occurs the need for enhancing the
overdraft limit at the respective Link Branches, the matter may be taken
up with State Bank Of India locally.

Corettdane

—Z-

4. All the Officers in Charge of Regional and Sub Regional offices shall
maintain continuous co-ordination with State Bank of India locally so that
dishonor of EPFO cheques are avoided for want of funds.

5. It is the responsibility of the Regional and Sub Regional Offices to have
appropriate interaction with the Link Branches of State Bank of India. If at
all, any problem is anticipated and not addressable locally, the matter
may be reported to ACC(Zones) for further taking up the issue at the level
of CGM/GM, Circle-in-charge.

6. APFC(Cash) is primarily responsible if any cheque is dishonored and
overall responsibility lies with RPFC-II(Finance & Accounts) in case of
Regional Office and RPFC-II & O-I-C in case of Sub Regional Offices.

The instances of dishonor of cheques will be viewed seriously and the
matter will be placed before the Competent Authority for fixing of
accountability.

Yours faithfully,

Regional P.F. Commissioner-!
(Finance & Accounts)

Copy to:

1. All ACCs (Zones) with a request to take periodical review so that the
dishonor of cheques is avoided .
2. RPFC(NDC) with a request to place the circular on official website.
